note: Produced-artifact dependency baseline (no-new-rot ratchet, cinatra#2537). `undeclaredProducesDeps` = a `cinatra.produces`/`consumes` entry whose target extension is NOT declared in the SAME manifest's `cinatra.dependencies` as a required artifact-kind edge — installing the producer therefore never installs the produced artifact and every run fails materialization. `unresolvedProducesTargets` = a produced target that does not resolve to a real artifact extension in the synced catalog (absent / wrong kind / unclaimed objectTypeId) — so declaring it as a dependency would not fix anything. `notes` carries the REASON each grandfathered (package, target) pair is tolerated — a manual, version-controlled record; NOT diffed by the gate. The tool-owner classes (cinatra#4874) map consumer -> key -> reason: `undeclaredToolOwnerDeps` = a tool the consumer uses whose owner (per the authz inventory) is another pack that is not in its cinatra.dependencies; `unownedTools` = a used tool whose owner cannot be decided; `dynamicToolNames` = a tool selection that is not a literal name. They fail on NEW and on STALE entries and only shrink against the base branch. These are CURRENT tolerated misses; the gate fails on NEW/GROWN entries. Regenerate the data with `node scripts/audit/extension-produces-deps-gate.mjs --write-baseline` — every data entry should only ever be REMOVED (fix the producing repo, then bump its pin), never added; carry `notes` forward by hand for anything re-baselined this way.

PREMISE CORRECTION vs the issue's audit table: the declared target `@cinatra-ai/default-artifact` is RETIRED (epic cinatra#1785 wave A5), its floor purged with a DB write guard (migration core__0059), its repo ARCHIVED, and it is absent from both extension locks — so the table's remedy (declare it as a required dependency) is not performable, and doing it would ship a dependency on a package that can never install. cinatra-ai/media-transcript-agent#42 instead re-points BOTH the produces entry and the OAS EndNode artifact binding to `@cinatra-ai/text-artifact` (the live artifact accepting the `text/plain` that binding already emits) and declares it as the required artifact dependency. Both entries drop out when the dev-lock pin is bumped.
